description:
As a new visitor, I want to create an account so I can place orders.

* All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
* An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
* Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
* A customer under 18 years old cannot register.
** Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.
** Password must be at least 8 characters.
** Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old."

criteria.text: All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
A customer under 18 years old cannot register.

cases.title: Register successfully with all required fields valid and sign in
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> in the first name field.
Enter <a last name> in the last name field.
Enter <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older> in the date of birth field.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters> in the password field.
Submit the registration form.
Sign out if the system signs the user in, then open the sign-in page.
Sign in with the email and password used in the registration.
cases.expected: The account is created and the sign-in with the registered email and password succeeds. (Exact confirmation wording is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Registration with an already-registered email is rejected and creates no duplicate
cases.preconditions: <an email address that already has a registered account> exists in the system.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name>, <a last name> and <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older>.
Enter <an email address that already has a registered account> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Submit the registration form.
Check the account list / customer records for that email address.
cases.expected: A clear error about the email already being registered is shown and no second (duplicate) account exists for that email. (Exact error text is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Invalid email format shows an inline validation error
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name>, <a last name> and <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older>.
Enter <a string that is not a valid email format, e.g. missing @ or domain> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the email field and the account is not created. (Exact error text is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Password shorter than 8 characters shows an inline validation error
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name>, <a last name> and <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older>.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter a password of 7 characters in the password field.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the password field (minimum 8 characters) and the account is not created. (Exact error text is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Password of exactly 8 characters is accepted
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name>, <a last name> and <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older>.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter a password of exactly 8 characters.
Submit the registration form.
cases.expected: No password length validation error is shown and the account is created.

cases.title: Customer under 18 cannot register
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> and <a last name>.
Enter a date of birth that makes the customer clearly under 18 (for example today's date minus 15 years).
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
Check the account records for that email address.
cases.expected: The message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown and no account is created.

cases.title: Customer whose 18th birthday is today can register
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> and <a last name>.
Enter a date of birth of exactly today's date minus 18 years.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Submit the registration form.
cases.expected: The age calculated from the date of birth is 18, the message "You must be at least 18 years old." is not shown, and the account is created.

cases.title: Customer who turns 18 tomorrow cannot register
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> and <a last name>.
Enter a date of birth of today's date minus 18 years plus one day.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: The age calculated from the date of birth is under 18, the message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown and no account is created.

cases.title: Submitting with a required field left empty does not create an account
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Fill in all required fields (first name, last name, date of birth, email, password) with valid data, leaving one required field empty: <the required field to leave empty>.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
Repeat for each of the five required fields in turn.
cases.expected: For each run, the form is not accepted and no account is created, because first name, last name, date of birth, email and password are required. (Exact error text and presentation are not specified in the story.)
